title: Codex, which lets businesses use stablecoins for cross-border payments across Asia, Latin America, and sub-Saharan Africa, raised a $30M Series A led by Pantera (Camila Grigera Naón/Fortune)
summary: Camila Grigera Naón / Fortune: Codex, which lets businesses use stablecoins for cross-border payments across Asia, Latin America, and sub-Saharan Africa, raised a $30M Series A led by Pantera — Money might make the world go round—but that doesn't mean getting it around the world is easy.
